games.description: A solo house investigation with Bella the dog. Sark follows paintings, keys, fuses and the family’s recordings, solves the later name puzzle, and leaves with Bella in ending three of four.
games.title: Baisu

games.description: A co-op cryptid hunt with APL. Sark and APL explore the forest, compare weapons and supplies, settle on a cave-side position, and take down BigFool before posing with the body.
games.title: BigFool

games.description: A co-op curse investigation with APL, following a separate Get Out session. The pair searches for books and the required objects, learns the defensive device, and finally burns the skull, knife, duck, and ball to lift the curse.
games.title: Dimensional Phobos Threat

games.description: A co-op haunted-house test with APL Fisher. The pair wrestle with launch and hosting trouble, search for cursed objects, and try to evade the fast pursuer before abandoning the unfinished run.
games.title: Get Out
